Seafile | File hosting and collaboration platform

summary.one_liner: Seafile is an open source cloud storage system for file sync, sharing, and team collaboration, with library-level encryption and built-in metadata and document features.
summary.what_it_does: This repository is the desktop sync client daemon for Seafile; the README describes the broader Seafile project, whose server core, web UI, and mobile apps live in separate repositories. Files are organized into libraries that can be synced separately, and a library can be encrypted with a user-chosen password. The README lists selective folder sync, history-based conflict handling, transfer of only content deltas with resumable uploads, and syncing with two or more servers. Sharing covers folders with users or groups, password-protected download links, upload links, and version control. It also mentions a virtual drive client with on-demand file sync, extensible file properties, tags, multiple file views (table, Kanban, gallery, map, statistics), and integrations with OnlyOffice, Collabora, Excalidraw, plus built-in SeaDoc and wiki features.
use_cases: private alternative to commercial cloud drives
how_to_run: See the README's 'Build and Run' section (linked externally; no commands given in this README)
notable: Libraries can be individually synced and encrypted with a user-chosen password
Conflict resolution based on file history rather than timestamps
Metadata management with table, Kanban, gallery, map, and statistics views
Built-in SeaDoc collaborative editor and wiki knowledge bases
caveats: This repo is only the sync client daemon; the server and other components are in separate repositories
Build and run instructions are not in the README itself
Some features are described as Pro-only in the context of bug reporting (Pro customers contact by email)
